§6Irradiator§f

§aTransmutes items using neutron bombardment.§f
The §bFission Irradiator§f sits inside a §bSolid Fission Reactor§f and uses neutron flux to transmute items placed inside it. It's not a standalone machine like the others. Place it as a component in your reactor structure and it processes items using the reactor's neutron economy.

The Irradiator converts materials into different isotopes or enriched variants. It's key for producing §bLEU-233§f, §bHEU-235§f, and other advanced fuels that can't be made through normal processing.

§ePS:§f The Irradiator's efficiency depends on its position relative to fuel cells and moderators. Place it where neutron flux is highest for best results.
